::: {.research-card}
## Pathogen Dynamics

We study how pathogens transmit, diversify, and emerge in wild animal populations by linking host traits, ecological communities, surveillance data, and quantitative models.
:::

::: {.research-card}
## Animal Movement

We study how animals move across changing landscapes and climates, and how those movements connect populations and shape ecological and disease processes.
:::

::: {.research-card}
## Global Changes

We investigate how climate and landscape change reshape host ecology and influence disease dynamics.
:::

::: {.research-card}
## Ecology

We study how species traits, populations, and communities shape disease transmission dynamics across space and time.
:::
